author: New China TV
description: Millennium City Park in Kaifeng, China's Henan, goes viral for its underwater chrysanthemum display, leaving visitors feeling like they've stepped into a Monet painting. Kaifeng is known as China's "Chrysanthemum City", with a long tradition of growing and celebrating these beautiful flowers.
title: Chinese theme park takes chrysanthemums underwater

author: New China TV
description:
"What I have seen the Chinese are doing in terms of protection of the rainforest, it's great. I think that's a good lesson that could be shared also with other countries."
An expert attending an international conference in Hainan, China, highlighted the global importance of rainforest conservation, emphasizing the need for community engagement and international cooperation.
title: Expert highlights community role, cooperation in rainforest conservation

author: New China TV
description: A marathon is underway, but how do pedestrians get across the road? Watch how police in Nanjing, China, use clever crossing arrangements to keep runners moving while helping local residents cross safely during the 2026 Nanjing Marathon. #NanjingMarathon #China #Marathon
title: How to cross a marathon route? Watch this!

description: For 50 years, the TAZARA Railway has linked Tanzania and Zambia. Now, a major upgrade is underway. Using archival footage and AI-generated scenes, we explore what the railway's future could look like.
title: 50 years on, what's next for this African railway?

title: Dubai Run, a citywide celebration of fitness

author: New China TV
description:
Take a breathtaking FPV flight across the Tongzi River grand bridge in southwest China's Guizhou Province!
With a main span of 965 meters, the bridge connects Renhuai City and Tongzi County, cutting travel time between the two from around two hours to just 20 minutes.
The bridge opened to traffic in September 2024. Now, see it from a whole new perspective!
#China #Guizhou #Bridge #FPV #Engineering
title: FPV drone captures sweeping views of mega bridge in China's Guizhou

description:
Overseas vlogger Yegor Shyshov explores Hebei's picturesque countryside, from a fishing town along Bohai Bay to a village deep in the Taihang Mountains. From fishery-solar projects and smart shrimp fry breeding to livestream-driven traditional crafts and solar-storage microgrids, these initiatives are fueling rural revitalization and breathing new vitality into local communities.
#Hebei #RuralRevitalization #GreenEnergy■
title: Overseas vlogger's journey in Hebei | Harmonious and beautiful villages

China Travel is reaching new heights with thrilling outdoor adventures! #ChinaTravel #Zhangjiajie

author: New China TV
description:
Welcome to Episode 1 of Shenzhen Diaries!
Today, we're hanging out with Walker, the amazing humanoid robot from Shenzhen.
Real-time conversation in multiple languages (Walker can speak 29 languages.) No fixed script, no pre-recorded lines. Just natural dialogue between the robot and our foreign explorer, Martina.
Watch to see how this Shenzhen robot responds to greetings and questions.
title: Show Me China | My Shenzhen Diaries (Ep.1): A smart robot friend
